title: Residence Districts Except R1 and R2 Districts

blocks.html: In all Residence Districts, except R1 and R2 Districts, a fire station may be enlarged or extended, provided that:
blocks.plainText: In all Residence Districts, except R1 and R2 Districts, a fire station may be enlarged or extended, provided that:

blocks.html: (a)        such enlarged or extended portion does not occupy more than 25 percent of the floor area or space which such non-conforming use occupied or utilized within the building or other structure at the time when it became non-conforming;
blocks.plainText: (a) such enlarged or extended portion does not occupy more than 25 percent of the floor area or space which such non-conforming use occupied or utilized within the building or other structure at the time when it became non-conforming;

blocks.html: (b)        such enlargement or extension shall not create a non-compliance or increase the degree of non-compliance; and
blocks.plainText: (b) such enlargement or extension shall not create a non-compliance or increase the degree of non-compliance; and

blocks.html: (c)        such enlarged or extended portion conforms to the applicable district regulations on accessory off-street parking spaces as set forth in Section 52-41 (General Provisions).
blocks.plainText: (c) such enlarged or extended portion conforms to the applicable district regulations on accessory off-street parking spaces as set forth in Section 52-41 (General Provisions).

blocks.html: Community facility bulk regulations as set forth in Article II, Chapter 4, shall apply to such enlarged or extended fire stations.
blocks.plainText: Community facility bulk regulations as set forth in Article II, Chapter 4, shall apply to such enlarged or extended fire stations.
